intro.h2: A Warren crew that shows up and gets it done
paragraphs: Wills Builders does home remodeling in Warren, PA, out of an office on Pennsylvania Avenue West. Our motto says it plainly: satisfied customers are our best ads. That is why we want every porch, siding job, kitchen and bath remodel to be one your neighbors notice and ask about.

One reviewer had seen the remodeling work we did for other people, called it amazing and said we are timely in starting and completing projects. Another calls us a great company for all your building needs. You will recognize our crew by the Wills Builders shirts and the company name on our white trailer.

services.h2: Home remodeling services in Warren, PA

items.name: Porches and entries
items.blurb: Front porches change how a house looks from the street. One porch in our photos has stone veneer column bases, square white posts, white railings and a gray shingle gable over the front door. Call to talk about a new porch or an update to the one you have.

image.alt: Front porch with stone veneer column bases, white posts and railings and a gray shingle gable

items.name: Siding and exterior updates
items.blurb: Gray vinyl siding and white trim can tidy up an older home. One of our photos shows a single-story house in fresh gray siding with white window trim and a wood deck railing along the side. Call to talk about siding, trim or other exterior work.

image.alt: Single-story house with gray vinyl siding, white window trim and a wood deck railing

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchen remodeling is the main category on our Google listing, and kitchens are part of the remodeling work our crew takes on. Call to talk about cabinets, countertops and flooring for your kitchen, and we will set up a time to look at the space with you.

items.name: Bathrooms, countertops and flooring
items.blurb: Bathroom remodeling, countertops and flooring round out our interior work. Whether it is one dated bathroom or new floors on the main level, call (814) 723-4190 and tell us what you have in mind. A reviewer says we are timely in starting and completing projects.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with a navy vanity, white tile tub surround and gray plank flooring

items.name: General building
items.blurb: We are builders as well as remodelers. One customer calls us a great company for all your building needs, and another describes a very professional crew. If you have a project around the house that does not fit a neat category, give us a call.

items.title: On time, start to finish

about.text: Wills Builders is a building and remodeling company based at 1513 Pennsylvania Ave W in Warren, Pennsylvania. Our motto is simple: satisfied customers are our best ads. Our team photo says a lot about who we are: the whole crew in Wills Builders shirts, lined up in front of the white company trailer with our name on the side. Outside, the crew builds porches and installs siding and trim. Inside, we take on kitchens, bathrooms, countertops and flooring. Reviewers call us timely, very professional, hard working and talented.

image.alt: Crew member in a Wills Builders 723-4190 hoodie on a foggy morning job site

process.h2: How a project with us works

steps.title: Give us a call
steps.text: Call (814) 723-4190 Monday to Friday between 8 AM and 3:30 PM, or email willsbuilders@westpa.net with a short description of the project.

steps.title: Look at the job
steps.text: We come out to see the porch, room or exterior, talk through what you want and answer your questions about materials and options.

steps.title: Plan and schedule
steps.text: You get a plan and price for the work and a start date. A reviewer says we are timely in starting and completing projects.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Our crew does the work, hard working and talented in the words of one reviewer, and keeps the project moving through to completion.

steps.title: Walkthrough
steps.text: We go over the finished work with you. If there is anything else around the house we can help with, keep us in mind.

items.name: Robin B.
items.text: I've seen the remodeling work this company has done for other people and it is amazing. They aim to please. They are timely in starting and completing projects.  One of their workers in particular is especially kind and friendly not only with customers but also their pets. My only reason for the lack of 1 more star for 5 is because of the workers interactions with eachother, not always respectful. But definitely hard working and talented!

service_area.text: Wills Builders is based at 1513 Pennsylvania Ave W # C in Warren, Pennsylvania, and our work is centered on Warren. Our own crew comes to your home for porches, siding, kitchens, baths and flooring. If you live outside Warren and want to know whether we can take on your project, call (814) 723-4190 during office hours, Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 3:30 PM.

items.q: What kind of work does Wills Builders do?
items.a: Home remodeling and building in Warren. Our photos show a front porch with stone column bases and white railings and a house re-sided in gray vinyl. We also take on kitchen and bathroom remodeling, countertops and flooring. One customer calls us a great company for all your building needs.

Our office is at 1513 Pennsylvania Ave W # C, Warren, PA 16365. Office hours are Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 3:30 PM. Please call (814) 723-4190 before stopping by to make sure someone is there to talk with you about your project.

We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 3:30 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (814) 723-4190 during those hours, or email willsbuilders@westpa.net with a short description of your project and the best time to reach you.

items.q: Will my project start when you say it will?
items.a: Being on time matters to us. A Google reviewer who has seen our work for other people says we are timely in starting and completing projects. When we schedule your job, you get a start date so you can plan around the work.

items.q: Can you do both inside and outside work?
items.a: Yes. Outside, we build porches and install siding and trim. Inside, we take on kitchen and bathroom remodeling, countertops and flooring. That means one local company and one phone number, (814) 723-4190, for projects both inside and outside your home in Warren.

final_cta.text: Call the Wills Builders office in Warren, Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 3:30 PM.
